name: Simple Block Randomizer
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Dev-Sebi
description: Randomizes which enabled hotbar slot is used on every block placement. Pick your slots once, then just click - no more scrolling between block variants mid-build.
works: Random build mode: R toggles it (action bar '[Block Randomizer] Random build mode ON'), a green '? RND (n)' indicator shows at the top left (gui 4,4) while on, and each block placed switches to a random enabled hotbar slot.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: its slot settings screen (key N) doesn't open; the random slot switch on placing isn't checked; the mod works without it
